lsu.config.customization.messages.header: Customize chat-related behavior and message formatting for private messages, tags, and filtered output.
lsu.config.customization.messages.pmform: Whether to enable custom private message formatting
Customize the format of private messages (/msg, /r)
lsu.config.customization.messages.disabl: Disables chat tags, such as [No-Life], from appearing in messages for visual simplicity.
lsu.config.customization.titlescreen.hea: Adjust silly little title screen tweaks.
lsu.config.customization.titlescreen.cus: Whether to enable custom splashes on the title screen
lsu.config.customization.resourcepack.he: Don't like the server's shield skins? Disable them. You might need to redownload the pack to see changes.
lsu.config.customization.resourcepack.ov: Toggle server-provided resource pack features individually. Reload the pack after changing to see the effect.
lsu.config.customization.resourcepack.en: Enables server emojis from the resource pack
lsu.config.qol.titlescreen.header_desc: Tweak title screen quality-of-life controls like quick join and panorama presentation.
lsu.config.qol.titlescreen.quickjoinbutt: Quick Join button on the title screen
lsu.config.qol.titlescreen.custompanoram: Custom panorama background on the title screen
lsu.config.qol.rareitems.header_desc: Qol features for rare items, including scaling and drop confirmation.
lsu.config.qol.rareitems.rareitemscaleen: Enable increased scale for rare items when dropped on the ground.
lsu.config.qol.rareitems.rareitemscale.d: Increased scale of rare items. 1 is regular size.
lsu.config.qol.desloppifychat.header_des: Set up words and phrases that should appear ghosted in chat.
lsu.config.qol.desloppifychat.enabled.de: Allows you to add custom words & phrases that you can 'ghost' in chat (making the messages appear in a boring gray!)
lsu.config.qol.desloppifychat.catchwords: List of words and catch phrases for the desloppifier. If they appear in a message in chat, the message will be shown in gray.
lsu.config.qol.autojoin.header_desc: Automatically connect into Lifesteal mode when joining the hub.
lsu.config.qol.autojoin.autojoinlifestea: Automatically join the Lifesteal gamemode when connecting to the lifesteal.net hub
lsu.config.qol.autoclicker.header_desc: Simple autoclickers are permitted for the purposes of AFK farming on Lifesteal Network. This feature has been designed from the ground up to be anticheat-proof, but as with all autoclickers, we advise you to record your gameplay with Replay Mod / Flashback / Medal. Toggle the autoclicker with the command /lsu ac toggle or by configuring a keybind.
lsu.config.qol.autoclicker.cps.desc: How many clicks per second should the autoclicker trigger? Capped at 10 for safety (why would you need more anyways?)
lsu.config.qol.customuis.header_desc: Enable or disable replacement interfaces provided by Lifesteal Utils.
lsu.config.qol.customuis.custombaltopint: Replaces /baltop with the Lifesteal Utils interface.
lsu.config.qol.potions.header_desc: Tools for viewing accurate potion information factoring in your prestige perks.
lsu.config.qol.potions.showactualpotiond: Show the actual potion duration in the tooltip (potion duration + your prestige perk boost)
lsu.config.qol.customuis.auctionui.desc: Replaces the auction UI with an entirely custom view.
lsu.config.timers.chaincounter.header_de: Track how charged up your UC is, just by looking at your HUD!
lsu.config.timers.chaincounter.format.de: Custom format for the unbroken chain counter display
lsu.config.timers.heavenly.header_desc: Show how much durability your heavenly item would have after triggering the enchant.
lsu.config.timers.heavenly.enabled.desc: Whether to enable the heavenly durability calculator HUD element
lsu.config.timers.heavenly.format.desc: Custom format for the heavenly durability calculator display
Show heavenly durability result as a numeric value or percentage
lsu.config.timers.customenchanttimers.he: Enable & customize timers for timer-based custom enchants!
lsu.config.timers.customenchanttimers.au: Automatically hide custom timers if you don't have the custom in your inventory
lsu.config.alliances.general.showallianc: Whether to show alliance tags in your own nametag and chat tag. Disabled by default, but could be good for aura screenshots and whatnot
lsu.config.alliances.general.header_desc: Configure alliance visuals and chat behavior, including prefixes, colors, and filtering rules.
lsu.config.alliances.general.enableallia: Whether to enable alliance features such as colored name tags.
lsu.config.alliances.general.alliancepre: Whether to render alliance prefixes in nametags
lsu.config.alliances.general.alliancenam: Whether to apply list-specific alliance name colors to player names
lsu.config.alliances.general.allowallian: Allow Alliance Members to Bypass Ghosted Chat Filter
If enabled, messages from alliance members are not ghosted even when patterns match.
lsu.config.alliances.allianceprefixprior: Edit the alliance priority list used to resolve displayed prefix and color when multiple alliances apply.
Alliance priority list for choosing which prefix and color to display
lsu.config.meow.messages.header_desc: Customize message formatting behavior for Meow mode.
lsu.config.meow.messages.pmformat.desc: Customize the format of private messages (/msg, /r)
